items.title: What Do Corning (GLW) AI Fiber Deals Mean For Its Growth Story?
items.summary: Corning (NYSE: GLW) has secured multi-year, multi-billion-dollar supply agreements with Meta and Zayo for advanced optical fiber solutions tied to AI data center and network buildouts in the US. The Meta deal focuses on high-capacity optical connectivity for next-generation AI data center infrastructure. The Zayo agreement centers on supplying optical fiber for large scale US network deployments that support AI driven traffic. These contracts signal a new phase for Corning as a key supplier...
